body:
Hey everyone - been a bit! Excited to announce our content drop rate related to Mounts of Mayhem, including new discoverable spear enchants, new Valor Shop relics, and a few enchant changes.

The quick overview is below, but check the full post for a more detailed breakdown: here

📋Overview

  • ⏫Rune Rush - Runs March 7th-8th, triggering Tier VI surges which each help begin a new spear enchant research project.

    • Tier VI surges:

    • Once started, the projects can be progressed via Boundary Fragments from Tier V surges or a no-cooldown research quest.

  • 🛡️Valor Shop - 2 new spear-related relics will be available:

    • 🦑Messina, a hybrid which starts as the trident Charybdis and becomes the spear Scylla when thrown, who can dash straight back to Charybdis!

    • ☢️G.A.M.M.A., a spear which can crush its victims' drops into Primordial Dust when you move very fast!

  • 📖Runecrafting - Buffs to Paradigm of Lust, and reworks for Paradigm of Wrath and Paradigm of Vainglory.

Thanks so much everyone for your patience with this update, and we hope to see a handful of you next weekend!

🫶
